newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady amid dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady amid dull trade.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates were steady on Monday for the second successive session as spinners waited for a relief package for the textile industry likely to be announced by the government, dealers said.

"Spinners are likely to enter the market after they have drawn up their strategy according to the package," one dealer said. The government is expected to lower duties on import of raw cotton and synthetic fibres to help the textile industry cope with a shortfall in domestic cotton output.
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 variety was traded at 2,150 rupees ($53.45) per maund (37.32 kg), dealers said.
